text:
emma: Starting v2 regional cutover to ap-southeast-1 in ~8m. Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% with 10m holds. Watch p95, 429s, and custom reserved-quota alarms.

deploybot: Rollout scheduled: id r-ap-07, start 6270004360, initial 5%. Pause conditions: errors > 1% OR p95 > 2x baseline OR reserved_quota_429 > 0.5% global.

hui: Heads-up: theres a config change in v2 that tightens token rounding for embeddings which can change quota math slightly for long-streaming sessions. We added a guard but want to watch tenants with committed throughput.

danny: Listing high-commit tenants in AP: tenant-omega, tenant-xpress, tenant-fin. Recommend preemptive pin for tenant-fin if we see anything odd.

infra-oncall: Canary started at 6270004360. Initial telemetry: p95 steady, global errors 0.2%. Monitoring per-tenant.

deploybot: Canary progressed to 20% at 6270004368.

infra-oncall: Alert: tenant-omega showing increase in quota denials (429) at 6270004374. Localized but above threshold for that tenant.

emma: Pause rollout. deploybot, pin tenant-omega to v1 and block retries on streaming for that tenant.

deploybot: Commands executed:
```
/deploy pause r-ap-07
/deploy pin tenant-omega v1
/edge throttle tenant-omega streaming_retries 2s
```
Pins live at 6270004378; canary paused.

hui: Investigated logs: rounding change + an aggressive client retry pattern caused token meter to read an extra frame on reconnects. Fix in PR #1047 adds idempotency on meter increment.

danny: Can we hotpatch edge only in AP canaries? If CI green, deploy edge fix and validate for 15m before resuming.

hui: Building `edge-v2.0.3-hotpatch-1` now. CI green on unit tests; integration batch running.

infra-oncall: After pinback, tenant-omega 429s subsided. Global metrics back to baseline.

emma: Good. Plan: deploy hotpatch to ap canaries, validate 15m, then resume with more conservative holds: 5% -> 10% -> 20% -> 50% with 15m waits. Also add a note to release notes about quota rounding.

release-notes: Draft entry created: "v2 rollout: embedding token rounding adjustment could cause transient quota 429s for some long-streaming tenants. A hotfix (edge-v2.0.3-hotpatch-1) was applied; impacted tenants were pinned to v1 during mitigation."

infra-oncall: Will open a short post-cutover checklist to confirm backports and add an integration test for reconnect framing.

emma: Thanks. Closing this thread; re-open after hotpatch validation and resumed rollout.
